status: coordinates_frozen_before_dem_acquisition_or_model_ranking; Pilot Valley source amended after coverage check, before model ranking
purpose: External geographic stress test of the existing terrain retrieval pipeline; no site or window may be added to model training, gallery development, threshold selection, or reranker tuning.

kilauea.selection: Fixed study center on the Kilauea volcanic slopes, independent of all retrieval scores; NASA identifies basalt landscapes at Kilauea as a Moon analog. This center is not asserted to be a NASA field instrument station.
kilauea.temporal_caveat: The 2017 terrain predates subsequent eruptions and may differ from current terrain or imagery.

lava_beds.selection: Fixed center within Lava Beds National Monument on the northern flank of Medicine Lake volcano, a NASA lava-cave analog region. Source availability checked before model ranking; this center is not a mapped individual cave opening or a verified bare-basalt sample.

pilot_valley.selection: Fixed study center within the Pilot Valley playa geographic bounds in the USGS hydrologic report, independent of retrieval scores; NASA discusses Pilot Valley salts as a Mars habitability analog. It is an environmental contrast, not a presumed morphological match.

acquisition_policy: For each fixed anchor, use every catalog 1 m tile from the selected project intersecting the recorded query bbox. Reproject into a 3 km local azimuthal equidistant square at 2 m. Require at least 99.5% valid pixels, preserve tile URL/ETag and output SHA. If coverage fails, document failure rather than move the anchor to improve a retrieval result.
amendments_before_model_ranking: First acquisition found Kilauea 2017 3DEP crop 0.000% valid; original coordinate retained pending the USGS 2019 Kilauea lidar release.

Added Lava Beds National Monument volcanic region as a third independent site after checking only DEM availability, before any model score or ranking. This is a supplemental site, not a replacement for the failed Kilauea source.

First acquisition found Pilot Valley UT_WestEast_B22 crop 0.493% valid; changed only the source project to UT_StatewideCenSouth_2020_A20 after a direct native raster coverage check at the unchanged anchor.
analysis_policy: Holdout sites may be used only for frozen-model evaluation. Any human relevance judgment must be blind to method/rank/site identity until submitted; at least two independent experts are needed for a scored claim. Known NASA analog context is not a positive label for every 200-1000 m window. Do not claim geographic generalization, material classification accuracy, or new analog discovery from an unjudged holdout.
limitation: Both sites use USGS 3DEP 1 m DEMs, so this is geographic and environmental holdout, not a sensor/source-family holdout. The Moon/Mars query sources were already used during model development.
